name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 13 - Am 14
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 13c. Calls for the creation of additional and targeted EU funding to expand and requalify public housing, combat speculation and defend the right of all to decent and affordable housing; calls, in this regard, for the creation of a specific budget line for public, social and affordable housing with EUR 5 000 000 000 in commitment and payment appropriations, dedicated to supporting the development, construction, rehabilitation and expansion of public housing stocks;
